cases.title: Discard password when Never For This Site is selected
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password after Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Available presented choices for multiple saved credentials
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Pick up changed password
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website is saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Disable password manager to stop save prompts and prefilling
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password in preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password in the password manager is saved, this information can be viewed in the password manager through preferences.

cases.title: Remove username and password for a given site
cases.description: Verify that removing a username and password for a given site results in it no longer autofilling on that site and no longer being listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all saved username and password information
cases.description: Verify that removing all username and password information results in no autofill on sites and nothing listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: All requirements have corresponding test cases mapped correctly, and no gaps, blockers, or redundant cases were identified.
All requirements are correctly covered by corresponding test cases without any blockers, gaps, or redundancies.
